desc:
🍳 WELCOME TO LEARN TO COOK! 👨‍🍳

Start with a tiny kitchen and work your way up to becoming a MASTER CHEF!

🔥 COOK delicious meals and unlock new recipes!
💰 EARN money by serving hungry customers!
🏪 EXPAND your restaurant and unlock new food stations!
👨‍🍳 HIRE chefs, cashiers, and staff to automate your restaurant!
⚙️ UPGRADE your kitchen, equipment, and restaurant!
⭐ DISCOVER new foods and become the ultimate chef!

Can you go from a beginner cook to a WORLD-CLASS CHEF?
